additional_info.subject: RE: ID0442657-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R3 313057296006]Router issue CRM:02681000600
additional_info.body:
Good Morning Liz,
Hope you're doing well.
We can see logs from this charger, which we could not previously.
This confirms the router replacement has resolved the issue and the router is now successfully setup.
However the charger is still offline in SCB as we understand it is updated to version 7, which is still currently being investigated by R&D on ticket [ID0428565].
For clarity, we request that any hotfix requests are made in separate technical support.
I do not have a field service report, so if this can be completed ASAP and submitted, we can raise the PO for the hours needed to replace the XF3 router.
Note: For future and ongoing works, POs should also be sent prior to any work commencements.
We had several people on leave when this was being undertaken, thus some processes being out of place.
With Kind Regards,
